regime_context: Canada/TSX shows a broad (8/16 eligible), two-narrative rotation with Oil & Gas Producers as the clear leader (score 2.24, margin 1.393 over Big Banks) and no single dominant narrative. The absolute-trend gate is validated for risk control on this market (gate_helps=true), but cross-sectional momentum rank has no forward edge; leadership is concentrated-in-flows but crowded (crowding_z 1.18) and unscheduled macro news share is at 1.0, so we are in a coincident regime read with high headline risk, not a prediction environment.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the crowded Oil & Gas leader (crowding_z 1.18) widens its margin over Big Banks beyond 1.4 while XEG.TO relative breadth stays above 0.9 — that would confirm rotation is still reflexively feeding oil and banks are not yet the handoff. The watch retires if XEG.TO breadth breaks below 0.85 without a fresh macro catalyst, signaling leadership dispersion rather than confirmed handoff.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the top non-crowded eligible theme (rank 2, score 0.847), durable (durability_bar 0.71), in a confirmed trend state (hurst_tag trend), broad (breadth 0.857), and un-crowded (crowding_z 0.44). The absolute-trend gate—the one validated risk-control leg—favors staying with durable trends while oil is crowded. This is a relative-stability lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Banks lag the energy leader by a wide margin (score gap 1.393) and rate/credit sensitivity could hit financials if macro surprise (unscheduled share 1.0) turns negative; ZEB.TO is a heavy, slow-moving basket.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XEG.TO by 3% or more over the next 20 trading days while oil holds its rank 1

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The leader is crowded (crowding_z 1.18, crowded=true) and its momentum is an attention signal with rank-IC ~0, not alpha. The one validated edge is drawdown control via the trend gate; crowding does not imply a short or fade (reflexivity), but it is a size-down caution. With no edge from chasing a crowded leader at an already-wide margin, the accountable stance is non-participation rather than fresh overweight.
evidence: leader of rotation with score 2.24 and margin 1.393
rank-IC ~0 on cross-sectional momentum per backtest verdict
unscheduled_share 1.0 raises jump risk for a crowded leader
theses.dissent: Oversold energy with high breadth (0.929) and heavy weight could continue a strong reflexive uptrend; legitimate trend-followers may hold size despite crowding because the absolute-trend gate has real drawdown value and the leader has the highest durability_bar among energy names.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO retains rank 1 and fails to underperform ZEB.TO by any meaningful margin over the next 10 trading days

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Pipelines show the cleanest trend texture in the table: breadth 1.0, hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.77 (highest among eligible themes), and un-crowded (crowding_z 0.69). Rank 3 and score 0.41 reflect the same energy leadership, but without the crowding flag on the producers. This is a relative-quality lean within the energy complex rather than a momentum call.
theses.dissent: This theme is not scorable (no ETF proxy) so accountability is weak; pipelines are rate-sensitive and a sharp macro surprise could hit infrastructure even in a durable trend. A broad energy unwind would drag pipelines with producers regardless of texture.

falsifier.text: TSE energy complex (XEG.TO composition) falls by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days while pipelines' relative breadth breaks below 0.8

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
